chapter: Claude Hopkins, Fletcher Henderson and Fats Waller
title: Ralph Cooper at the Apollo and Baron Lee
summary: Six weeks at the Apollo with Ralph Cooper, and work with Baron Lee.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: I'm just trying to think of some of the other bands you might have done some gigs with.
I worked with Ralph Cooper; he had six weeks in the Appollo, and I went in the Appollo for six weeks.
That's right; he practically opened that place.
I went in the Appollo for six weeks.
How about Baron Lee; you never worked with Baron Lee?
I worked with Baron Lee too.
Baron Lee had just come back from South America and he always wore full dress, and--
(Side A of Tape 3 concludes at this point.)
